question: ________ unemployment refers to the time lag between jobs when an individual is searching for a new job or is switching between jobs.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Frictional**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Frictional unemployment** refers to the time lag between jobs when an individual is searching for a new job or is switching between jobs.
 
• It is a natural form of unemployment that occurs even in a healthy economy.
